def calculate_balance_increase_rate(loan_df, account_df, trans_df):
    # Find the first approved loan for each client
    first_approved_loans = loan_df[(loan_df['date'] == '1993-07-05') & (loan_df['status'] == 'APPROVED')]

    client_account_ids = first_approved_loans['account_id'].unique()

    filtered_trans = trans_df[
        (trans_df['account_id'].isin(client_account_ids)) &
        (trans_df['date'] >= '1993-03-22') &
        (trans_df['date'] <= '1998-12-27')
    ]
    
    # Calculate the initial and final balances for each client
    initial_balances = filtered_trans[filtered_trans['date'] == '1993-03-22'].groupby('account_id')['balance'].sum().reset_index()
    final_balances = filtered_trans[filtered_trans['date'] == '1998-12-27'].groupby('account_id')['balance'].sum().reset_index()
    
    # Merge initial and final balances
    merged_balances = pd.merge(initial_balances, final_balances, on='account_id', suffixes=('_initial', '_final'))
    
    # Calculate the increase rate
    merged_balances['increase_rate'] = (merged_balances['balance_final'] - merged_balances['balance_initial']) / merged_balances['balance_initial']
